verdict.rationale: doola documents its own Registered Agent service, with digital access to physical mail via the dashboard and a separate public-facing address for privacy. Nothing in the evidence says this service covers every US state; the only state-specific mention is the MCP server's Wyoming LLC flow. missing for 10: documented all-50-state registered-agent coverage, evidence of adding a new state under the same provider, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state coverage.
